name: Facebook
overview: Scripture highlights the importance of genuine friendship and truthfulness in relationships, reminding us that true friends show themselves friendly and can be closer than a brother (Proverbs 18:24). In the context of communication, believers are cautioned to guard their hearts against harmful words and to value truth, even when it is difficult or opposed (Ecclesiastes 7:21; Galatians 4:16). The gospel is to be proclaimed widely despite opposition, and faith grows through hearing the Word of God (Matthew 24:14; Acts 28:22; Romans 10:17). These principles guide how Christians should engage with platforms like Facebook, emphasizing truthful, loving dialogue and faithful witness.
